note: GDELT-derived geopolitical questions. Pre-cutoff mention stream is the live-signal check; post-cutoff events resolve ground truth.

items.text: Will Bashar al-Assad remain President of Syria through June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if Assad holds the office of President of Syria on 2013-06-30.

items.text: Will Greece remain a member of the euro area through June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if Greece is a euro-area member on 2013-06-30.

items.text: Will Iran and the P5+1 announce a nuclear agreement by June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if a publicly announced nuclear accord (interim or final) between Iran and the P5+1 is issued on or before 2013-06-30.

items.text: Will Mohamed Morsi remain President of Egypt through June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if Morsi holds the office of President of Egypt on 2013-06-30.

items.text: Will the Democratic People's Republic of Korea conduct a nuclear test by June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the U.S., CTBTO, or the DPRK itself reports a DPRK nuclear test explosion on or before 2013-06-30.

items.text: Will Israel conduct an overt military strike on Iranian nuclear facilities by June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if Israeli forces carry out an acknowledged strike on Iranian nuclear sites on or before 2013-06-30.
items.prior_source: U.S. and Israeli official statements, spring 2012

items.text: Will the UN Security Council adopt a resolution authorizing military force in Syria by June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the Council adopts a Chapter VII use-of-force authorization for Syria on or before 2013-06-30.
items.prior_source: Chapter VII Syria draft success rate, 2011-H1 2012

items.text: Will Xi Jinping become General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party by June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if Xi is named CCP General Secretary on or before 2013-06-30.

items.text: Will the euro area admit a new member state by June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if any country adopts the euro as its currency on or before 2013-06-30.

items.text: Will the Kofi Annan six-point plan produce a sustained nationwide ceasefire in Syria by December 31, 2012?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if a nationwide ceasefire under the Annan plan holds for at least 14 consecutive days ending on or before 2012-12-31.

items.text: Will Egypt sign an IMF loan program by June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if Egypt and the IMF announce a staff-level or board-approved arrangement on or before 2013-06-30.

items.text: Will a UN-authorized or French-led military intervention begin in Mali by June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if French or UN-authorized forces commence combat operations in Mali on or before 2013-06-30.
